summary: Cleans up a mutex/semaphore-style object. If ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects fails (non-zero return), aborts immediately returning -1. Otherwise unlinks the object from its doubly linked list, and if non-null releases its scene node and frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Then clears global dword_8B8F28 to 0 and returns 0.

local_names.a1: the object being cleaned up (list node / resource handle)

operations.description: Guard on ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects(a1): if it returns non-zero (DirectX cleanup failure), abort by returning -1.
DoublyLinkedListUnlink(a1): remove the object from its doubly linked list.
If a1 is non-null, call ReleaseSceneNode(a1) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(a1) to release the scene node and free the object.
dword_8B8F28 = 0: clear the global UI/context pointer after cleanup.

unresolved: Owning object type, and what dword_8B8F28 holds (UI root context per existing analysis), are unconfirmed.
Which DirectX resource fails in ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects and why a failure aborts the whole cleanup are unknown.
